plugins.name: NetBox Sync
plugins.description: Keep Termix hosts in sync with the devices and virtual machines in NetBox, filtered by tags.
plugins.author: tabisch
features: Import NetBox devices and virtual machines as hosts
Pick what to sync by NetBox tags, match any or all of them
Exclude tags and filter by status
Sync on a schedule, update changed hosts and tag, keep or delete removed ones
Folders from site, role, tenant, platform or cluster

versions.notes:
### Added

- Sync NetBox devices and virtual machines into Termix hosts
- Filter by tags (any or all), excluded tags and status
- Preview a sync before running it
- Sync by hand or automatically on a schedule
- Keep, tag or delete hosts that leave NetBox
- Folders from site, role, tenant, platform or cluster
- SSH port and username from NetBox custom fields
- Link existing hosts with the same address
